notes.title: Detroit Pistons
notes.body: Detroit's NBA team, whose rough title teams of 1989 and 1990 were called the Bad Boys. She likes bad boys, and he's never been one.

notes.title: Mike Lowrey
notes.body: Will Smith's Miami detective in the Bad Boys films. Bad Boys for Life had come out that January, and the name follows the bad boy line before it.

notes.title: Jadeveon Clowney
notes.body: The defensive end who became famous at South Carolina for a helmet-popping hit in the 2013 Outback Bowl in Tampa. Hitting hard is the point.

notes.title: Downy Unstopables
notes.body: Downy's laundry scent beads. Anyone who acts invincible gets compared to fabric softener.
His exes compare notes in a group chat and agree they saw his fall coming. It's a funny image, and the kind of phone drama that runs all through his songs.

notes.title: Swimming Pools (Drank)
notes.body: Kendrick Lamar's 2012 single about drinking and peer pressure. He squeezes its hook into half a line.
He tells the relationship like a road test she failed, which fits a song named for red lights. By the end of the verse he's tried again, it's over, and he's worn down but at peace with it.

notes.title: Shundor
notes.body: In Bengali, shundor means beautiful. He uses it as a name for himself, signs this song off with it, and brings it back on Life is Verses.
